import subprocess
result = subprocess.run(['git', 'log', '--oneline', 'base..HEAD'], capture_output=True, text=True)
print("Commits on top of base:", result.stdout.strip() if result.stdout.strip() else "(none)")

# Check what the base looks like
result = subprocess.run(['git', 'show', 'base:src/semver/version.py'], capture_output=True, text=True)
base_content = result.stdout
base_lines = base_content.split('\n')

# Check if re.ASCII is present in base
for i, line in enumerate(base_lines):
    if 're.ASCII' in line or 're.VERBOSE' in line:
        print(f"Base line {i+1}: {line}")
    
# Check if strip check exists in base
for i, line in enumerate(base_lines):
    if 'strip()' in line:
        print(f"Base line {i+1}: {line}")
